name: Sakuraba Ema
source:
A friendly girl who refers to herself using the self-pronoun 'Boku'. She is a clumsy girl who always finds herself making mistakes, and needing someone else to look after her. She loathes the feeling of loneliness, and enjoys basking in the warmth of others. Her friendly nature results from her fear of being left alone. She possesses a sharp mind, having the capability to make sharp deductions and reasonings, with excellent observational skills. However, she deliberately makes mistakes, out of a fear of being disliked otherwise. However, when it comes to helping someone else, she shows extraordinary deductive skills. She possesses a strong will to never give up, continuing to endure, no matter what the situation may bring.

Original Sin: Abomination. 
Magic: ???

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Ema_Sakuraba]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Extended profiles are from the [url=https://https://manosaba.com/]Official Site[/url].]
